notes.problem: A thin pan in a dark void with stray pebbles; the 55 bar 0.83 of the 70.
notes.fix: An orthographic TXBENCH plan relief like frame 2, both bars from one lit zero saw cut, filling 40 to 50 percent of the height, the ratio checked in screen pixels.

notes.problem: A strip about 8 percent of the frame between a dead sky and a dead foreground; a flat curb band; arbitrary pebbles.
notes.fix: Eye about 0.6 m, about 1.8 m off the pan at fov 28, pan and bars corner to corner across the lower half; remove the pebbles; curb to the asphalt's value.

notes.problem: Two thin strips across an eighth of the frame; empty navy above, pebbled brown ground below.
notes.fix: Rebuild as a TXBENCH plan relief in frame 2's unit, 70 and 55 in two blocks from one zero edge, filling half the height.

notes.problem: Broad beige bar tops in the mid tones, no single focal; the nearest bar under the footer.
notes.fix: Key the bar tops into shadow so only chamfers catch the key; stop the nearest bar above the footer; bring the terracotta warning panel into the left foreground.

notes.problem: Bar tops one broad mid-tone band; a stair-stepped near shadow; a colour fringe bottom right.
notes.fix: Darken the top albedo so only the chamfers catch the key; raise shadow map size; crop the fringe.

notes.problem: Diagonal beige planks with no subject; the lower half mid-tone paint; no scale; the nearest bar under the footer.
notes.fix: Bring the terracotta warning panel and the lit kerb lip into the lower left third; key the bar tops dark so only chamfers catch light; end the nearest bar above the footer.

notes.problem: The field bleeds both edges and reads as wallpaper; far rows as bright as near.
notes.fix: Pull back so all 400 sit inside with a dark margin; light a pool on the front rows and the amber row.

notes.problem: A uniform tan pattern at 432; the amber markers about 10 px on the claim line; prism faces navy-black.
notes.fix: Eye about 0.6 m at fov 28 with the amber row about 25 percent up from the bottom; warm the prism faces.

notes.problem: The six brass markers about 12 px in the bottom row against the claim line.
notes.fix: Camera back and up so the brass row sits about 70 percent down, clear of the footer; scale the brass markers 1.5 times one marker width ahead of the block.

notes.problem: A tan kerb wedge upper left, gutter-lip aliasing, bars flat quads.
notes.fix: Kerb and gutter albedo to the asphalt's value; raise the shadow map resolution so each bar casts.
A rim light from the key side, cloth normal maps, dolly in to about a third of the height.

notes.problem: A flat dim rectangle with hard edges and little pool falloff; reads as a grille.
notes.fix: Tighten the pool on the start bar and row 1, near black by row 3; a lit kerb edge at the top.

notes.problem: Flat black windshield, primitive body, a hard ground edge left of the car.
notes.fix: An environment reflection in the glass; extend the ground under the fog.
